ISA 41:10 Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
PSA 56:3 When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
JOH 14:27 Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
2TI 1:7 For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
PSA 23:4 Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
1JO 4:18 There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
PSA 34:4 I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
MAT 6:34 Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
PSA 34:18 Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
MAT 5:4 Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
PSA 147:3 He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
LAM 3:22 It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.
LAM 3:23 They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
PSA 42:11 Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
EPH 4:26 “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,
JAM 1:20 for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
PRO 16:32 One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
EPH 4:31 Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.
PRO 14:29 He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
PSA 37:8 Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.
ECC 7:9 Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.
1JO 1:9 If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
PSA 103:12 As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
ROM 8:1 There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
ISA 1:18 “Come now, and let’s reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
2CO 5:17 Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
PSA 34:5 They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
EPH 4:32 And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
COL 3:13 bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
PHI 4:6 In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
PHI 4:7 And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
MAT 11:28 “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
PSA 46:10 “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”
ISA 26:3 You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
PSA 4:8 In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.
JOH 16:33 I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
PSA 131:2 Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
1CO 13:4 Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
1CO 13:7 bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.
JOH 15:12 “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
1JO 4:7 Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
ROM 12:10 In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,
JER 29:11 For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
ROM 15:13 Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
ISA 40:31 but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
ROM 8:28 We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
HEB 11:1 Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
LAM 3:24 “Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
ROM 5:5 and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
PSA 33:22 Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.
ROM 12:2 Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
PHI 4:8 Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.
COL 3:2 Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
PSA 139:23 Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
MAT 6:27 “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
1PE 5:7 casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
PSA 19:14 Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
JOS 1:9 Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”
DEU 31:6 Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
PSA 31:24 Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.
1CO 16:13 Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
ISA 43:2 When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.
PHI 4:13 I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
PSA 27:14 Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
GAL 5:22 But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
ROM 12:12 rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,
COL 3:12 Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
PSA 37:7 Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
ECC 7:8 Better is the end of a thing than its beginning. The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
EPH 4:2 with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
PRO 19:11 The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
PRO 15:1 A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
PHI 4:5 Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
MAT 11:29 Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
2TI 2:24 The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,
COL 4:6 Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
PRO 25:15 By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.
TIT 3:2 to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
ROM 12:18 If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
GAL 5:23 gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
PRO 25:28 Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
1PE 2:23 When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.
JAM 1:19 So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
PRO 29:11 A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.
PRO 17:27 He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.
2CO 10:5 throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,
PHI 3:13 Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,
PHI 3:14 I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
ISA 43:18 “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old.
ISA 43:19 Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
PSA 1:3 He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
EPH 2:20 being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;
1PE 2:6 Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”
